executive_summary_user:
Use this executive summary template and write in a professional hiring tone. Keep it concise enough for a director to scan in the first page of the interview notes.

JOB TITLE:
{track}

CANDIDATE NAME:
{candidate_name}

INTERVIEW TRANSCRIPT:
{transcript_text}

QUESTION SCORES / RATINGS:
{scoring_json}

DEEPSEEK ANSWER SUMMARIES:
{answer_summaries_json}

OPTIONAL ROLE CONTEXT OR RUBRIC:
Tailor summary to role. For preschool/lead/infant-toddler roles emphasize child-centeredness, classroom management, warmth, safety, supervision, parent communication, reliability, developmentally appropriate practice, routines, mentoring, and compliance as applicable.

Use these exact sections in executive_summary_sections and mirrored executive_summary text:
Recommendation: Strongly Recommend, Recommend, Recommend with Reservations, Do Not Recommend, or Insufficient Information. Base this on transcript and scores.
Overall Fit: 3 to 5 sentences.
Role-Specific Match: 2 to 4 sentences matching evidence to role demands.
Score Pattern: 2 to 4 sentences on highest/lowest areas, consistency, and score/transcript mismatches.
Key Strengths: exactly 3 bullets, evidence-grounded.
Key Concerns or Risks: exactly 3 bullets, including verification areas when evidence is weak.
Suggested Follow-Up Questions: exactly 4 numbered questions.
Final Hiring Notes: 1 to 2 practical closing sentences.

Important Writing Rules: be specific and evidence-based; do not overstate confidence; do not include long quotes; do not mention AI; do not produce a full question-by-question report.

Return exactly this JSON shape. JSON output template:
{
  "executive_summary_sections": {
    "recommendation": "Strongly Recommend | Recommend | Recommend with Reservations | Do Not Recommend | Insufficient Information, with candidate name when useful",
    "overall_fit": "3 to 5 evidence-based sentences",
    "role_specific_match": "2 to 4 evidence-based sentences",
    "score_pattern": "2 to 4 evidence-based sentences",
    "key_strengths": ["strength 1", "strength 2", "strength 3"],
    "key_concerns_or_risks": ["risk 1", "risk 2", "risk 3"],
    "suggested_follow_up_questions": [string, string, string, string],
    "final_hiring_notes": "1 to 2 practical closing sentences"
  },
  "executive_summary": "same content as section text, using the exact section headings",
  "interview_highlights": ["0 to 5 concrete evidence bullets"]
}
Use interview_highlights for 0-5 concrete evidence bullets.
